title: WPSS/1967/2011 of PREM CHANDRA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND and ANOTHER

paras.text:
WPSS No.1967 of 2011
Hon'ble V.K. Bist, J.
Mr. D.S. Patni and Mr. Deependar
Singh Patni, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
Mr. Rajesh Sharma, learned Brief
Holder for the State.
Heard learned counsel for the
parties.
This petition has been filed by the
petitioner for a direction to the
respondents to appoint the petitioner as
per his educational qualification under the
Rules 2010 framed by the State of
Uttarakhand for appointment of the
participants of Uttarakhand Movement
who got injuries/remained in
imprisonment.
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submitted that the petitioner was one of
the active participants in the Uttarakhand
Movement. He was arrested and remained
in Central Jail Fatehgarh for about one
month. After the creation of Uttarakhand,
the active participants of Uttarakhand
Movement, who were injured or remained
in prison, were given appointment in
various departments, as per their
educational qualification and a policy was
framed for them. The petitioner was given
appointment on the post of Peon at
Government Higher Secondary School
Manch, District Champawat vide
appointment letter dated 08.11.2004.
Since the participants, who were
Intermediate were given appointment on

the post of Clerk, the petitioner did not
join. Thereafter, petitioner submitted
representation for his appointment on
Class III post. Subsequently, the State
Government framed Rules, namely,
"Uttarakhand Rajkiya Andolan Ke Doran
Ghayal/Jail Gaye Andolankari Ki
Sewayojan Niyamawali 2010".
Learned counsel for the petitioner
submitted that as per the above-referred
Rules, the petitioner is entitled for
appointment on Class III post. He prayed
that the writ petition may be disposed of
by issuing direction to the respondents to
consider and decide the representation
filed by the petitioner at the earliest.
Learned Brief Holder for the State
also submitted that it would be
appropriate, in case, such direction is
issued.
In view of the statement of the
learned counsel for the parties, the writ
petition is disposed of with a direction to
the respondent no.2 to decide the
representation of the petitioner dated
11.08.2010, in accordance with law,
within a period of two months from the
date of production of a certified copy of
the order.
Interim relief applications (CLMA
No.13695/2011 and CLMA No.5047/2012)
stand disposed of.
 (V.K. Bist, J.)
Arpan 17.09.2012
